inventory_summary: Inventory: 184 resolved walls (main 50, second 46, basement 37, attic 26, garage 4, foundation/court/yard 21), 4,511 framed wall members, 67 headers, 36 doors with their king/jack/header packs, plus S-601 stock rows. Measured from the resolved model (pickled) with probes in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-colincatlin-Documents-NoCloud-TypeHaus/fc951bd3-20bf-434f-9b45-0a1dac7cd982/scratchpad/geometry-review/F1/: per-wall stack (frame_base_z_m vs base_ref_z_m, plate-bottom, stud z0/z1, top plates, joist soffit above); stud cut lengths vs storey stack and stock; every header against its overlapping top plates; stud/king/jack gaps and overlaps; door RO/header/jack packs for all interior doors changed by the 2026-11-03 retype; cripples; lapped-corner plate coverage.
